name: StackedBar
summary: Parts of a whole by status, in one bar: inner segments are square so small parts stay legible, a hairline of the surface between them; only the outer ends of the whole bar are rounded. A legend under the bar names every part with its share. Status colours only: categorical series arrive with the first chart, from the spectrum. Not for progress over time (use Progress) or for comparing values that aren't parts of one whole.
a11y: The bar is `role="img"`, named by the label and every part with its share in order; the legend repeats it as words for sighted readers and is hidden from assistive technology, so it isn't read twice.

props.name: label
props.description: What the whole is, e.g. "Checks". Read before the parts.

props.name: legend
props.description: Each part's name and share as words under the bar, beside its colour, so colour is never the only cue. On by default; turn it off only when the same numbers are written right beside the bar.

props.name: label
props.description: What the part is, read out with its share, e.g. "Passed".

props.name: share
props.description: Its share of the whole, 0 to 100. Shares should add up to 100.

props.name: status
props.description: The status the part stands for; its colour is that status's fill.
